brief.subject: Bills due before payday? You can ask to move the date
brief.headline: Bills Due Before Payday? Asking for a New Due Date Can Help
brief.dek: Shifting bill due dates can smooth cash flow, Atmos cards raise welcome offers, and the FTC sues to block a playground-equipment merger.
brief.lede: If your bills land before your paycheck, asking creditors to move your due dates is a simple way to ease the squeeze.

sections.heading: Line Up Due Dates With Payday
bullets: You can request a change to a bill's due date, which helps when payments hit before your paycheck arrives.
Matching due dates to your pay schedule can make your monthly cash flow easier to manage.

sections.heading: Atmos Cards Boost Sign-Up Bonuses
bullets: Two Atmos Rewards credit cards, the Ascent and the Summit, raised their welcome offers to as much as 100,000 points.
A bigger bonus only pays off if you can meet spending requirements without carrying a balance or paying interest.

sections.heading: FTC Moves to Block Playground Merger
bullets: On 2026-10-19, the FTC sued to stop PlayPower, owned by Platinum Equity, from buying rival BCI Burke.
The agency says combining two of the largest commercial playground makers would weaken competition on price and quality.

brief.seo_description: Today's household money brief: shifting bill due dates to match payday, Atmos card welcome offers, and an FTC suit over a playground merger.
